The '''Imperial Supply Freighter''' was a type of [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the time of the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Rebel operatives managed to steal one such [[Starship/Legends|starship]], along with codes to infiltrate the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="manual">''[[Star Wars: The Interactive Video Board Game]]'' [http://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Assault_on_the_Death_Star_VCR_Board_Game.pdf instructions manual]</ref>
